learning_outcomes.text: The student is informed about most important advanced manufacturing processes available for shaping materials: laser, EDM, ECM, waterjet, FSW, additive. Sheet forming processes are also described with fundamentals of formability concepts.

syllabus_topics: Hammers and Presses: machines based on energy, stroke
Laser advanced manufacturing and Additive manufacturing processes

assessment_methods.method: Script examination with practical analysis of manufacturing sequences
